scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @legendforge/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @legendforge/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm run typecheck:api
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
